clips.title: The story
paras: Blackwood Den lies under the Blackwood furbolgs’ corruption in southern Darkshore, near Ashenvale. The cave and camps that were once their peaceful home have fallen into madness. Volcor, a night elf scout, is trapped in the cavern and awaits aid from Auberdine.

Blackwood furbolgs hold a rocky cave and crude camps near the southern border of Darkshore and Ashenvale. Corruption has taken hold of the tribe, and its members attack outsiders. Deep inside the cave, the night elf Volcor is pinned down and in danger. Scouts and travelers from Auberdine are needed to help him.
